title: NLM: Request/reply handling
description:
Request the actual length necessary in the tvb_get_ptr call, avoiding
a possible buffer overrun (only really possible I believe with IP
fragmentation or similar, due to the way the ws_buffer is allocated.)

Use FT_FRAMENUM and the appropriate types for the request and response
fields, and mark those and the time until response as generated items.

Refactor the request and reply matching into common functions.

Since the request and reply matching uses the data from the cookie,
but is performed first, make sure we don't throw an exception fetching
the cookie (throwing an exception while catching the cookie len is
acceptable, as it doesn't affect the dissection to hit a bounds error
there instead of at the beginning of dissect_rpc_opaque_data.)
